subject.title: feat: serve signed publisher feed projections

question: Should ClawHub adopt signed publisher-feed endpoints and the required production signing-key rollout as a supported public contract now, or keep this feed-distribution track out of the core API until it is sponsored?
rationale: The PR creates externally consumed routes, signing semantics, and a fail-closed deployment requirement; correctness testing cannot decide whether this is the intended permanent API and operator commitment.

options.title: Pause until feed direction is sponsored
options.body: Keep this draft open but do not merge until an owner confirms the public contract, consumer trust profile, and production key rollout.

options.title: Adopt the contract deliberately
options.body: Approve the feed API and signer rollout, then require the prerequisite PRs to land and this branch to be rebased to a narrow integration diff.

options.title: Decline the core API surface
options.body: Close the draft if maintainers decide that publisher-feed distribution should not become a supported ClawHub core contract.

recommendation.title: Pause until feed direction is sponsored
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open but do not merge until an owner confirms the public contract, consumer trust profile, and production key rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior exact-head review of the publisher-feed contract is the strongest available signal for who can route the API-direction decision.
